array.string: root="$HOME/Library/Application Support/Panels"; export USER="$(id -un)" LOGNAME="$(id -un)" PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin" PLAN_CONFIG_PATH="$root/config.yaml" PLAN_DB_PATH="$root/state/planner.db" PLAN_DISPATCHER_LOCK_PATH="$root/state/dispatcher.lock" PLAN_HERMES_HOME="$HOME/.hermes" PLAN_LOGS_DIR="$root/logs" PLAN_BACKUP_DIR="$root/state/backups"; exec "$root/current/bin/panels-launcher" environment cleanup --apply
